changelog: Added permanent world vehicle persistence: saves exact vector4, mods, fuel, dirt, and physical damage (burst tyres, broken doors/windows) on exit, crash, or disconnect, and respawns automatically across server/resource restarts.
Added public garage slot limits (1 free slot + purchasable slots up to 5, doubling from $12,000, plus 2 VIP slots marked Soon) and $50,000 direct retrieval fee.
Separated impound vehicles completely from public garages so impound is only accessible at dedicated impound locations.
